concept.hr: Poruke o isteku TTL-a crtaju put, a zvjezdice nisu kvar
concept.en: TTL-exceeded replies map the path, and stars are not failures

summary.hr: Sonde s TTL-om 1, 2, 3 … umiru skok po skok i svaki usmjernik javlja tko je; jedan šuti, a put ipak radi. ICMP i UDP sonde, vatrozid na odredištu.
summary.en: Probes with TTL 1, 2, 3 … die hop by hop and each router says who it is; one stays silent, yet the path works. ICMP and UDP probes, a firewall at the end.
